text:
Alex S: @Marie CSM urgent escalation — customer Velum (VLM-42) showing a provisioning failure impacting trial activation and first-pay conversion. Support created INC-5891. About 50% of provisioning attempts return 403 or timeout over the last 48h. Renewal conversation scheduled next Thu; they asked about SLA and throughput during onboarding. Need CS to pick up comms and a mitigation plan so we don't lose the deal.

Marie CSM: ack — can you paste the error examples and the timeframe? who on eng is looking? priority level from support?

Alex S: log snippet below (repro from support env):
```
POST /v1/provision HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "customer_id": "VLM-42",
  "plan": "trial"
}
Response 403:
{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "code": 403,
  "message": "Provisioning quota reached for region us-west-2"
}
```
Occurred since 2025-11-04 03:20 UTC spikes. Ticket has engagement from eng-runtime (jon-eng) and infra. Support marked P1 for the account due to renewal timeline. We can repro with the curl above.

Sanjay (CSM): thanks. Two quick asks: 1) Does Velum require data isolation / private deployment for compliance? 2) If this is quota, can we offer a temporary manual uplift while infra scales? I can propose a short-term play: manual reserve + a calm, transparent customer note.

Alex S: Velum asked about private options in the last call but hasn't signed Private yet — they expect hosted capability to work. We can request manual uplift from Dedicated provisioning team; estimated 24–36h if approved. Eng says fallback to smaller batch size reduces errors for some customers (workaround).

Priya AE: renewal is at risk if we don't show a clear remediation timeline. Suggest offer: "we'll provision an emergency uplift for 14 days while we complete scale-up" + a one-time onboarding credit. Need CS to own the customer communications and confirm acceptance. I'll be on the call for renewal discussion.

Marie CSM: draft comms below — please edit. I propose to send within 1 hour after alignment.

Marie CSM: "Hi Team (Velum),
We’re sorry for the provisioning disruption you’ve seen. Support has opened INC-5891 and our engineering team is working on a fix. Short term we can apply an emergency capacity uplift for 14 days to stabilize activations. We will: (1) apply uplift within 24h if you agree, (2) run a stability test together, (3) provide a detailed post-mortem and next steps for long-term capacity. Priya from our team will join the renewal call to discuss next steps and any credit. Please reply to confirm and we’ll schedule a remediation window. — Marie (CS)"

Sanjay (CSM): looks good. I'd add: "we'll share an ETA for uplift by EOD and schedule a 30m remediation call within 48h."

Alex S: support can keep the incident page updated. I've added the internal runbook pointer: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/provisioning-quota and assigned INC-5891 to eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-5891 status changed to "escalated" (eng-runtime).

Marie CSM: owner: Marie (send comms + coordinate uplift). Action items:
- Alex S: keep incident notes and logs (ongoing) — due: ongoing
- Jon/eng-runtime: confirm uplift feasibility + ETA — due: 2025-11-06 18:00 UTC
- Marie: send customer note + schedule remediation call — due: 2025-11-05 12:00 UTC
- Priya AE: prepare renewal talking points / credit proposal — due: 2025-11-05 12:00 UTC

Priya AE: I’ll draft the renewal notes and proposed 14-day credit; will sync with finance if needed.

Marie CSM: I'll send the comms now and loop Velum execs. Marking as high priority; will update this thread once uplift ETA confirmed. :white_check_mark:
